summary: Leading the latest batch of tour announcements, Adéla has revealed a ten-date North American headline run, which will follow her previously-announced European and UK run. title: Superbloom ends after five editions due to venue constraints
summary: Germany’s Superbloom Festival will not return, with organisers citing venue renovation works that have made it “impossible” to continue the annual event. Based in Munich’s Olympic Park, the Goodlive/Live Nation festival has run since 2022, quickly becoming a fixture in Germany’s festival landscape.
